note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of ee1025b381. RFC 7947 Section 2.2.2.1 read: "As a route server does not participate in the process of forwarding data between client routers, and because modification of the AS_PATH attribute could affect the route server client BGP Decision Process, the route server SHOULD NOT prepend its own AS number to the AS_PATH segment nor modify the AS_PATH segment in any other way." The only unit change is one claim line on TestReactorForwardRSTransparent: the deleted ExtractASPathPrependOps is replaced by its live successor prependASPathOps (aspath_edit.go, called from filter_library.go), a parenthetical naming the operator-policy path the test does not exercise; the body, its RS-client destination and its byte-identical assertion are unchanged, so the claim states no more than the test checks. Its positive discrimination record is new: a hand-written PAIRED break in reactorForwardRSSection, line 582 '!facts.rsClient' -> true with line 594 'facts.rsClient && communityPolicy != nil' -> false. Read against the producer, the pair is a faithful break: the first guard alone lets the automatic local-AS prepend be set for an RS client but the RS branch overwrites intent.Prepend with RSPrepend (empty without a community request), the second alone leaves no prepend set; together the route server prepends AS 65000 toward the RS client, exactly the behaviour the sentence advises against, and nothing else changes for this input (non-RS peers already took the first branch; the unit carries no prepend community). Solo greens are recorded beside the paired red. Negative TestReactorForwardRSEBGPPrepend (record at line 582 -> false), the RelayStoredRoute pair, bgp-rs-relay-aspath-transparency.ci (exact bytes for rs-client and non-RS receivers) and the BIRD-side checkRouteServerASPath are unchanged. The EBGPPrepend unit's growth-only assertion remains weaker than an exact path oracle, covered exactly by the .ci and the relay pair. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
